title: The Psalms
subtitle: All 150 psalms by type, author, book and collection, with the ones the New Testament quotes
summary: The Psalms are Israel's prayer book and hymnal, and the book the New Testament quotes more than any other. This study lets you see the whole collection at once: what kind of song each psalm is, who wrote it, which of the five books it belongs to, and which psalms the apostles and Jesus Himself took up as speaking of Christ.
